listing.name: Wave Race 64 Recompiled
listing.summary: Experimental Wave Race 64 renderer prototype; upstream has not published a playable game package.

steps.title: Understand the current prototype
steps.instruction: This upstream currently reports only two boxes of visual noise, with no published player archive. A managed download would not supply the missing playable implementation. Its README asks for your own USA Rev A Wave Race 64 Z64 dump, but BUILDING.md still contains inherited Majora’s Mask/Zelda64 commands; do not substitute that other game or treat those commands as a verified Wave Race preparation guide.

steps.title: Preserve an already registered development copy
steps.instruction: Keep any already registered Wave Race development copy and its complete folder under its existing contract. You or upstream own runtime updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings; retain those files separately. Portcove does not supply a playable package or managed update, backup or rollback for this copy. New installation and registration remain on the existing useful-output hold. Reconsider them when upstream demonstrates useful runnable output and supplies a title-specific reproducible preparation or player package.
